reviews.decision: Root ADR 1198 — Required is checked at export and named in Submission::owed; no processor refusal is specified
reviews.verdict: Reaffirm the bounded policy, with an explicit coverage gap at the host decision seam.
reviews.reason: Table 227's condition is checked when the submit-form action is composed. Table 240 separately makes an explicit choice: IncludeNoValueFields set requires a name-only entry despite missing V; clear omits that field. §12.7.6.2 requires submission on invocation and supplies no instruction to cancel for a missing Required value. ADR 1198 correctly stops at a report and does not claim that the ISO itself mandates the host's behavior.

reviews.decision: Root ADR 1062 — composition in pdf-model; transmission decision at viewer-host
reviews.verdict: Reaffirm composition/policy separation; add an end-to-end no-network assertion for an owed Required field.
reviews.reason: Core carries owed sentences into Event::Reported before Event::Submit. viewer-host::may_submit is the owner-controlled policy decision. Existing host tests cover levels separately, but do not establish that a nonempty Required diagnostic remains visible while Send/Ask/Refuse choices continue to work.

reviews.verdict: Do not treat absence of a host block as an unmet ISO requirement.
reviews.reason: The Required sentence concerns field state at export; the clause gives no cancel/refuse algorithm, and Table 240 explicitly defines name-only submission for a valueless field when bit 2 is set. Refusal/ask behavior is an owner policy choice.
